positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
7Factor software is a software and cloud services company focused on helping build innovation into all aspects of your software delivery pipeline. We focus on solving the industry's toughest problems in high availability systems design, software engineering and architecture, and site reliability design. We are cloud native human centric experts in our field.

We offer public/private cloud native, execution, and maintenance of quality first software and enterprise infrastructure solutions. We build Good Things.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect our data visualization component suite in React and React Native, programming customizable dashboards and charts that can be configured to individual clients’ needs
- Contribute to and maintain a large library of reusable components
- Design and streamline API contracts that are used by customers to view and analyze their historical shipping data
- Coordinate deployments with developers and testers as release engineer, implementing strategies that reduce errors in production and facilitate CD best practices

positions.title: Ecommerce Account Manager
positions.description:
-Created best practices using Microsoft Excel to streamline interaction between internal systems and customers
-Analyzed inventory flows to suggest price reductions and make sure goods are flowing out of the warehouses

positions.title: Logistics Specialist
positions.description:
-Coordinated with international brokerage companies, finding solutions for the more time-sensitive shipments
-Worked closely with the development and management teams to improve our user interface
